title: Chhattisgarh to deploy AI road monitoring system for PMGSY roads
description: Chhattisgarh will deploy artificial intelligence to monitor rural roads. An AI-based system will identify road defects through monthly video surveys. This technology-driven approach aims to improve transparency and speed up repairs. A pilot project begins this Saturday, inspecting one road per district. Results will be analyzed before a statewide expansion of the system.
